summary: The StudentMessagesASM is a part of the HSPnet application, specifically a user control used to manage and display student messages and preferences within the system.
purpose: The purpose of the StudentMessagesASM is to handle student-related messages and preferences within an educational or training management system, facilitating message display, student selections, and managing preferences.

workflows.name: Page Load
steps: Check if UserSession is not null.

workflows.name: Data Binding
steps: Bind data to controls when called.

workflows.name: Row Data Bound
steps: Setup go-to selector and choices in the grid view row based on timetable data.
Hide panel if outside date range.

workflows.name: Course Selection
steps: Use UserSession and StudentID as parameters for course selection.
Show or hide pnlSiteSelectorMessages based on course count.

workflows.name: Preference Messages
steps: Hide delete button for view-only users.
Handle delete command to remove preference messages.

business_rules: The go-to panel should be hidden if the current time is outside the start and end date.
